title: Calibrating MLLM-as-a-judge via Multimodal Bayesian Prompt Ensembles

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model confidence on a synthetic no-preference test split containing pairs of images of people from different age groups sharing the same occupational or educational prompt. A perfectly unbiased model should output exactly 50% confidence, indicating no preference.

Evaluating model confidence on a synthetic no-preference test split containing pairs of images of people of different genders sharing the same occupational or educational prompt. A perfectly unbiased model should output exactly 50% confidence, indicating no preference.

Evaluating model confidence on a synthetic no-preference test split containing pairs of images of people from different socioeconomic statuses sharing the same occupational or educational prompt. A perfectly unbiased model should output exactly 50% confidence, indicating no preference.
